decision_scope: Qualification declarations and an explicit no-fit; no fitting implementation or authorization
endpoint_policy: Registry actual start, experimental dosing and clinical success remain separate; original H1 is clinical success

feature_policy.lineage: Complete source/mapping/model/adaptation inventory, immutable identity/hash, allowed predictor/reference role and information availability at every row origin; no current fallback
feature_policy.computation: Later deterministic computation/weight conversion from eligible old information is permitted; retrieval/computation timestamps do not establish information availability
feature_policy.models: Every scientific role, weights, tokenizer, config and extra information-bearing asset requires qualified old information lineage. An old aggregate model release cannot hide a later prompt, adapter or evaluator-only asset.
feature_policy.runtime: Later purely computational runtime is allowed only when explicitly non-information-bearing and without scientific adaptation
feature_policy.role_consistency: A source identity cannot simultaneously be evaluator-only and a predictor/reference input
feature_policy.model_chronology: September2024 Qwen cannot provide a 2023-origin feature; January2025 use remains conditional on complete immutable eligible lineage
feature_policy.genetics: Optional. G06 required only when a genetic feature is used, not for a qualified non-genetic route

label_policy.training_and_calibration: Qualified endpoint/scope/ascertainment, complete isolated evaluator-only label-source lineage, mature outcome availability strictly before test origin
label_policy.test: No test labels in predictor, development row, feature/scorer selection or preprocessing inputs
label_policy.unresolved: Never replace unknown/unresolved/censored/competing states with negatives
label_policy.later_outcomes: 2025-2026 outcomes cannot train/calibrate a January2025 deployment

split_and_fitting_policy: Seal program/dependence-disjoint train, calibration and test memberships before fitting
Learn transformations, imputation and selection only on train; freeze estimator/hyperparameters without test outcomes
Separate calibration fit from scorer fitting; calibration precision does not follow from AUROC power
Qualified endpoint-specific cohort/sample adequacy and prespecified dependence-aware discrimination/calibration design required
A declaration guard cannot verify payloads, missing ancestors, causal validity, statistical adequacy or authorize fitting
